result.brief: 系统对比 DINO/MAE/CLIP 类地球观测与通用编码器的冻结表征质量，发现卫星预训练并非可靠选择标准，且嵌入轮廓系数几乎完美预测 k-NN 与检索性能。
result.reason: Matched-pair study of DINO/MAE/CLIP encoders evaluating frozen visual representation quality and embedding geometry for downstream transfer, directly informing visual representation learning.
